responsibility: This header defines the `lazily_created<T>` template, a small host-side utility for deferring construction of an expensive auxiliary object until some consumer actually needs it. It stores a mutable `std::unique_ptr<T>`, provides a cached `get_or_create` accessor for const contexts, and requires subclasses to implement `create_object`; its role is reusable lazy-initialization infrastructure for optional compiler data such as richer diagnostic-side structures that many output sinks never request.
